title: Authenticate resumable field3 complex log corpus
objective: Define a deterministic resumable hash-named capsule protocol for all 301 field3 complex log columns, with ordered authenticated merge into the complete weighted complex owner

oracles: Qualified selected-prefix field3 complex log owner
Exact immutable capsule and ordered merge checks

runs.summary: Built and merged 76 synthetic immutable capsules into 2107 cells, preserved 32 authentic selected-prefix columns byte-identically, and passed seven negative controls

handoff.summary: Implemented an authenticated 76-batch resumable protocol for the bounded field3 complex-log kernel, immutable hash-named 0444 capsules and receipts, ordered gap/overlap-resistant merge into 2107 cells, and byte-identical compatibility with all 32 selected-prefix columns. No heavy batch was started.
risks: The batch worker is source-complete but intentionally has not yet been exercised under the heavy native runtime
The 3.8--4.8 hour serial estimate is extrapolated from the qualified focused run rather than measured across the corpus
next_steps: After explicit resource authorization, run one deterministic batch and inspect its immutable capsule/receipt before scheduling the remaining 75
After all batches exist, pass their paths in schedule order to --merge and independently inspect the complete owner receipt
Integration owns broad native and strict suites
